description: A pure Node.js, zero-dependency CLI expense ledger. Supports categories, expense records, budget statistics, and Markdown report generation via CLI commands that read/write JSON files.

workers.description: Category core: defines category objects, createCategory, updateCategory, filterCategories, categoryHelpers.
workers.taskDescription: Create 5 JavaScript files in workspace/worker-1/src/. File1 categoryTypes.js: export category object fields (id, name, monthlyBudgetCents, status, tags, createdAt, updatedAt), normalizeCategoryInput, isCategoryActive, getCategoryById. File2 createCategory.js: export createCategory(input) that creates a category with auto-generated id and timestamps. File3 updateCategory.js: export updateCategory(category, patch) returning immutable updated copy. File4 filterCategories.js: export filterCategories(categories, filter) by status, name substring, tag. File5 categoryHelpers.js: export helper utilities. Use require() and module.exports. No external packages.

workers.description: Expense core: defines expense objects, createExpense, updateExpense, filterExpenses, expenseHelpers. Imports from W1.
workers.taskDescription: Create 5 JavaScript files in workspace/worker-2/src/. File1 expenseTypes.js: export expense object fields (id, categoryId, description, amountCents, spentAt, merchant, tags, createdAt, updatedAt), normalizeExpenseInput, isExpenseInMonth, sumExpensesCents. File2 createExpense.js: export createExpense(category, input) that validates category is active (import isCategoryActive from worker-1) and creates expense with auto id. File3 updateExpense.js: export updateExpense(expense, patch) immutable update. File4 filterExpenses.js: export filterExpenses(expenses, filter) by categoryId, date range, amount range, tag. File5 expenseHelpers.js: export getCategoryById from worker-1 helper re-exports. Use require() cross-worker imports. No external packages.

workers.description: Budget engine: budget statistics, comparison against categories, budget helpers. Imports from W1 and W2.
workers.taskDescription: Create 5 JavaScript files in workspace/worker-3/src/. File1 budgetTypes.js: export BudgetSummary, PeriodBudget objects. File2 calculateBudget.js: export calculateBudget(categories, expenses) computes totalSpentCents, byCategory breakdown, overBudgetCategories. Imports sumExpensesCents from worker-2 and getCategoryById from worker-1. File3 getBudgetSummary.js: export getBudgetSummary(categories, expenses, period) returning monthly vs budget comparison. File4 compareBudgetToCategory.js: export compareBudgetToCategory(category, expenses) returning spent vs budget diff. File5 budgetHelpers.js: export budget utility functions. Use require() cross-worker imports. No external packages.

workers.description: CLI + Report: CLI entry point, JSON file I/O, Markdown report generation, artifact validation. Imports from W1, W2, W3.
workers.taskDescription: Create 7 JavaScript files in workspace/worker-4/src/. File1 cliMain.js: export cliMain() that reads categories.json, expenses.json from data/ dir, calls budget calculation, and writes ledger.json and report.md. Uses only fs, path built-ins. File2 writeLedgerJson.js: export writeLedgerJson(categories, expenses, budget, filePath) serializes ledger.json with structured data. File3 buildReportMarkdown.js: export buildReportMarkdown(budgetSummary, categories, expenses) generates full Markdown report. File4 validateLedgerFile.js: export validateLedgerFile(filePath) checks file exists and has valid JSON. File5 readDataFiles.js: export readDataFiles(dataDir) reads and parses categories.json and expenses.json. File6 reportHelpers.js: export formatCents, renderTableRow, formatDate helpers. File7 cliTypes.js: export CLI types. Import from worker-1 (filterCategories, getCategoryById), worker-2 (filterExpenses, sumExpensesCents), worker-3 (calculateBudget, getBudgetSummary, compareBudgetToCategory). Use require() and module.exports. No external packages, only Node built-ins.

acceptance.description: Worker 1 creates 5 JS files: categoryTypes.js, createCategory.js, updateCategory.js, filterCategories.js, categoryHelpers.js.
Worker 2 imports from W1 and creates 5 JS files: expenseTypes.js, createExpense.js, updateExpense.js, filterExpenses.js, expenseHelpers.js.
Worker 3 imports from W1, W2 and creates 5 JS files: budgetTypes.js, calculateBudget.js, getBudgetSummary.js, compareBudgetToCategory.js, budgetHelpers.js.
Worker 4 imports from W1, W2, W3 and creates 7 JS files including cliMain.js, writeLedgerJson.js, buildReportMarkdown.js, validateLedgerFile.js, readDataFiles.js, reportHelpers.js, cliTypes.js.
Structural gates pass. Runtime scenarios execute with Node.js. CLI artifacts (ledger.json, report.md) generated and validated.
